groups.aroundNotOnMap: around of group "{name}": "{path}" is not placed on this map
groups.aroundShape: around of group "{name}" is a list of paths of boxes on this map (as the keys of places)
groups.aroundWithPlace: group "{name}": around frames the boxes by itself, so it cannot be written with topLeft or size
groups.carry: carry of group "{name}" is true or false (false moves the frame alone)
groups.color: color of group "{name}" is one of blue, green, amber, violet, red, or null for none (not {value})
groups.duplicate: There is already a group named "{other}" on this map (names are compared ignoring case).
groups.fill: fill of group "{name}" is one of none, check, stripes, diagonal, dots, zebra, zebraDiagonal (not {value})
groups.headerPlace: headerPlace of group "{name}" is one of topLeft, topRight, bottomLeft, bottomRight, hidden (not {value})
groups.label: label of group "{name}" is text of up to 120 characters, or null to remove it
groups.moveShape: groups of move is a list of the names of groups on this map
groups.name: A group's name is 1 to 80 characters with no control characters: "{name}"
groups.needsPlace: A new group needs topLeft or around: {name}.
groups.new: new of group "{name}" is true or false (true makes it only, refused when a group of that name is already on this map)
groups.noSuch: There is no group named "{name}" on this map (groups: {names}).
groups.notHere: {path} cannot hold groups. Groups go on section maps and on the contents maps of goals and container kinds (a ui section boxes things with frame parts).
groups.shape: groups is {<name>: {topLeft, size, around, label, headerPlace, color, fill, name, carry, new} or null} (example: {"Auth": {"topLeft": {"x": 0, "y": 0}, "size": {"w": 24, "h": 14}}})
groups.size: A group's size is 6–1000 cells wide and 3–1000 tall: {w}×{h}.
groups.sizeShape: size of group "{name}" is {"w": integer, "h": integer} (both)
groups.strayKeys: group "{name}" has keys that are not accepted: {keys}. Accepted: topLeft / size / around / label / headerPlace / color / fill / name / carry / new
groups.tooMany: A map holds at most 200 groups.
groups.valueShape: group "{name}" is an object {topLeft, size, …}, or null to delete it (its cards stay)
